structure.unit: Other Regulated Providers of Financial Services

law.text:
This chapter shall not apply to:
Any person who: a. Does not hold itself out to be a check cashing service; b. Is principally engaged in the bona fide retail sale of goods or services; c. Either as an incident to or independently of such a retail sale from time to time cashes items; and d. Charges a fee or other consideration for the service that does not exceed the greater of $2 or two percent of the amount of the item; or
Any person authorized to engage in business as a bank, savings institution, or credit union under the laws of the United States or any state.
